name: DVOL crush continuation — implied-vol collapse confirms a stabilizing uptrend (long spot)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC + cross-event op (dvol cross_down x momentum). dvol-calm-regime-momentum reads a STATIC low DVOL level. This reads the EVENT — DVOL crossing DOWN through a level (a vol CRUSH / implied-vol collapse) — as a distinct catalyst: a vol crush after a stress episode is the options market actively re-pricing calm, and when it coincides with price momentum turning UP, it marks a regime TRANSITION from fear to a stabilizing uptrend (the post-capitulation grind begins as hedges are unwound and the vol risk-premium normalizes). Mechanism before data: long spot when dvol crosses DOWN through a fitted level (the crush) AND a short ret is positive (price stabilizing up); exit when dvol spikes back up (fear returns) or barriers fire. The novelty vs dvol-calm-regime-momentum is the DERIVATIVE event (the crush transition) rather than a steady-state level, and vs g2-dvol-spike-oversold-reversion it is the OPPOSITE leg (vol falling + price up = continuation, not vol rising + price oversold = reversion). Disconfirmer 1: replace cross_down with a dvol LEVEL lt — if the static read matches the deflated Sharpe, the crush-timing adds nothing (duplicates the calm-momentum spec). Disconfirmer 2: drop the momentum arm — if a bare vol crush matches, it is a vol-direction proxy. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): DVOL daily next-day-available; net of ~20bps the continuation must clear. tier0 dvol + tier0 ret_Nd, fresh DVOL prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: dvol crosses down (implied-vol crush) WHILE price momentum turns up — a fear-to-stabilization regime transition, ridden on spot
